summary: For each synchronized detection and depth pair, send stage 2 only the pallet select_detection already chooses, and write both sides of that split onto the result the handling process reads. PalletPoseStamped gains the chosen candidate's source index as the pallet sent through stage 2, and the source indices of the other class-matched candidates in that same Detection2DArray as deferred. Those indices are the slots extract_detection_candidates already stored. The message already carries this pair's RGB and depth stamps, so the roster is this capture while the scene can still change. When the estimate fails, the same two lists go on the failure diagnostic, which is the only result that path publishes. The two early returns that publish nothing stay as they are. Stage 2 still runs once. The user named which detections are sent versus deferred; the part they did not name is that both lists sit on PalletPoseStamped, the pose result for the AGV controller, rather than only on a diagnostic the success path does not use.
hypothesis: on_pair already holds every class-matched candidate and drops the ones select_detection does not choose before publish_pose, so the controller's pose names neither the sent index nor the deferred indices of this pair; writing those indices onto PalletPoseStamped, and onto the failure diagnostic when no pose is published, is the sent-versus-deferred split for this synchronized capture.
